name: shinchantw_cbt_first_day_cohort_compare_20260730_132509_796635
sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目：蜡笔小新繁体 CBT 与新加坡 Android 首个完整自然日对比
分母：各自首日 new_role 去重账号；只统计创角用户在同一自然日内的行为。
刷新参数：2026-07-29 至 2026-07-29；本查询固定复盘开服首日 2026-07-29。
================================================================================
*/

WITH TC_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Android AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_os' AND tag_value = 'Android'
),
SG_Singapore AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
RawEvents AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS cohort_date,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_name" AS event_name,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time,
        TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS BIGINT) AS role_level,
        TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
        TRY_CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1) AS revenue_usd,
        v.sandbox,
        v.is_freebuy
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x
      ON v."$part_date" = x.ex_date AND v.pay_currency = x.currency
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡Android' AS cohort_name,
        DATE '2026-05-08' AS cohort_date,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_name" AS event_name,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time,
        TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS BIGINT) AS role_level,
        TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
        TRY_CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1) AS revenue_usd,
        v.sandbox,
        v.is_freebuy
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Android a ON v."#user_id" = a.user_id
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x
      ON v."$part_date" = x.ex_date AND v.pay_currency = x.currency
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT cohort_name, cohort_date, account_id
    FROM RawEvents
    WHERE event_name = 'new_role' AND account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
CohortEvents AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM RawEvents r
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c
      ON r.cohort_name = c.cohort_name
     AND r.account_id = c.account_id
),
UserStats AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_name,
        c.cohort_date,
        c.account_id,
        MAX(e.role_level) AS max_level,
        MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'stage_fight' AND e.stage_type = 1001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS main_stage_player,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN e.event_name = 'charge'
             AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS payer,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN e.event_name = 'charge'
             AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN COALESCE(e.revenue_usd, 0) ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_usd
    FROM CohortUsers c
    LEFT JOIN CohortEvents e
      ON c.cohort_name = e.cohort_name
     AND c.account_id = e.account_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    cohort_name AS "用户组",
    CAST(cohort_date AS VARCHAR) AS "首日日期",
    COUNT(*) AS "首日创角人数",
    SUM(payer) AS "首日付费人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(payer) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "首日付费率(%)",
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd), 2) AS "首日收入(USD)",
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "首日ARPU(USD)",
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(payer), 0), 2) AS "首日ARPPU(USD)",
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(max_level AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS "平均最高等级",
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(max_level, 0.5) AS "最高等级中位数",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(main_stage_player) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "主线参与率(%)"
FROM UserStats
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;
